title: Sales
description: Open an in-stock product in Products to record a sale.
noResultsHint: Try a different product name, code, or date.
alreadyRecorded: A sale has already been recorded for this product.
unavailable: This product is unavailable for sale.
noRates: No current old-gold rates are available.
paymentCoverage: The payment must cover the full balance after trade-ins.
defaultPayment: Leave payment details blank to record any remaining balance as paid in {{currency}}.
exchangeRateHint: Enter the amount in {{currency}} equal to 1 {{paymentCurrency}}.
invalidField: Check this value. Use a decimal point for fractional amounts.
invalidTradeIns: Check the trade-in entries and selected rates.
checking: Checking whether the sale was recorded…
checkRequired: The sale status could not be confirmed. Check it before submitting again.
checkedInStock: The product is still in stock. You can try recording the sale again.

errors.currencyChanged: The sale currency changed. Review the updated currency, amounts, and rates before submitting again.
errors.conflict: The sale could not be recorded because the product or sale data changed. Check its current status.
errors.productMissing: The product could not be found.
errors.saleMissing: The sale could not be found.
errors.invalid: Check the sale details and try again.
errors.invalidPayment: Enter a payment that covers the full balance after trade-ins, or remove it if no payment is due.
errors.paymentTooLow: The payment is below the balance after trade-ins. Enter an amount that covers the full balance at the selected exchange rate.
errors.paymentNotDue: There is no remaining balance to collect. Remove the payment to finish this sale.
errors.generic: The sale could not be recorded. Try again.
errors.unknownOutcome: The sale status could not be confirmed.
